conversation.Statement: Hello, am I speaking with Riley Harper? This is Matt from Amazon Customer Protection. I see you recently used your Amazon account on a new device. I just need a quick confirmation.
Uh, yeah, this is Riley. I just signed in on my laptop today.
Thank you, Riley. For your security, we've noticed some unusual purchase attempts on your shared account. No need to worry, I'm here to help secure your account and prevent any unauthorized charges.
Wait, what kind of purchases? I haven't bought anything yet.

It looks like someone tried to order an Apple Watch and some electronics from a location not associated with your usual login. We take your security very seriously. Can you confirm your email address linked with the account?
Yeah, it's rileyharper99@gmail.com.

Great, thank you. I see your account is flagged for a possible compromise. To protect your funds, our protocol requires we temporarily lock your account and process a security verification. Please don't worry, this is reversible once we confirm your identity.
Am I going to lose access? I need to order my textbooks.
No worries, Riley. As long as we complete the verification now, you'll retain access. Could you please verify the current phone number on your account for me?
Thank you. Now, to ensure this isn't a fraudulent login from someone else, I need you to confirm your billing address as it appears on your Amazon account.
It's 102 Maple Lane, Apt 3C, Stillwater, OK.

Perfect, I appreciate your cooperation. For an extra layer of safety, we'll need to initiate a secure refund process for the unauthorized purchase attempts. You'll receive a refund verification code on your email shortly. Let me know when you see it.
Okay, I'll check my inbox. Should I be worried about my bank info?

There's no need to panic. This is a precautionary measure to safeguard your information. We also require that you confirm your linked payment method. Could you tell me the bank name you use with this Amazon account?
It's Central Credit Union.
Thank you, Riley. I see your refund verification code has been sent. Please read the code back to me so I can proceed.
Okay, here it is: 384920.

Excellent. Now, as part of the security protocol, we need to temporarily reverse the pending charge. The fastest method is to use instant Amazon gift cards, which are fully refundable once this is resolved. This process is strictly for your protection.
Wait, you want me to buy gift cards? Why can't you just refund it?

I understand this seems unusual, but due to the nature of the suspected fraud, Amazon requires an external verification using our partnered gift card process. The amount will be returned to your balance within an hour. Please stay on the line with me throughout for your safety.
Alright, but how much do I need to get?

To match the unauthorized transaction amount, please purchase two $200 Amazon gift cards. Once you have the cards, I'll guide you through the refund application. The funds are 100% protected and you'll see the reversal after we complete the check.
So I just go to a store and buy them? And then what?

Exactly, please visit a nearby store, purchase two $200 Amazon gift cards, and keep the receipts. Once you have them, let me know and I'll walk you through entering the codes into the Amazon refund system. Stay on the line while you do this for your security.
Okay, I can head to the student center store now. Will this lock my account or mess anything up?

No, your account will remain active, and this will ensure it's fully protected. This is a temporary hold to verify you're the legitimate account holder. Please notify me as soon as you have the cards so I can promptly assist you.
Alright, I'm at the store. I just got two $200 Amazon gift cards.
Great work, Riley. Now, on the back of each card, you'll see a claim code. Please read those codes to me, one at a time, so we can enter them into Amazon's secure refund portal.
The first code is AGT4-9843-TY67, and the second is PR5L-2231-YU88.
Thank you. I've entered the codes into our system for refund processing. Please hold while I verify the refund has been initiated. Are you still with me?
Yeah, I'm still here. When will I see the money back?
Refunds usually process within 30 to 60 minutes. As a final verification, could you log in to your Amazon account now and confirm if you see any new notifications or changes to your balance?
I don't see anything new yet, just the usual order history.

That's expected for now. Sometimes it takes a short while for the system to update. If you don't see the refund in the next hour, please call this number again and ask for me directly, Matt in Customer Protection. Is there anything else I can assist you with at the moment?
No, I think that's all. Thanks, I guess. I hope this fixes the issue.
You're welcome, Riley. Rest assured, your account is now under enhanced protection. If you receive any suspicious messages or calls, contact us immediately. Have a great day and stay safe.
